rows.label: Aya

groups.activity: buy the Scourge Prime relics she stocks, 1 Aya each
groups.meta: only while Scourge Prime is in Prime Resurgence

rows.label: Scourge Prime relics
rows.note: buy extra Blueprint and Barrel relics: they carry the Rares

conditions: Her stock rotates away; relics and Aya you hold never expire.
Vaulted relics and the parts themselves still trade between players.
bonuses: Varzia is also in the Market's Prime Resurgence tab.

groups.meta: Blueprint and Barrel are the bottleneck

rows.label: Scourge Prime Blueprint
rows.note: Lith S14 or Axi S9 or Axi S11 or Axi S12 or Axi S15, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Scourge Prime Barrel
rows.note: Meso S11 or Meso S12 or Meso S13 or Neo S15 or Axi S10 or Axi S14, Rare: 10% Radiant

rows.label: Scourge Prime Blade
rows.note: Lith R2 or Lith R3 or Meso A4 or Meso N16 or Meso V7 or Neo C4 or Neo M4 or Neo N18 or Axi A16, Common: 25.33% Intact

rows.label: Scourge Prime Handle
rows.note: Lith C9 or Meso C8 or Meso G4 or Neo K5 or Neo T6 or Axi K11 or Axi T11, Uncommon: 20% Radiant

conditions: Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant (100 Void Traces each); leave the Blade relics Intact, since Radiant lowers their Common odds to 16.67%.
Mission rewards never drop Resurgence relics; Varzia is the only source.
bonuses: Pick a teammate's identical reward at the reward screen; they get 5 bonus Void Traces.

rows.label: Scourge Prime
